name: World Liberty Financial USD
oneLiner: USD1 is World Liberty Financial's Trump-affiliated dollar stablecoin, issued 1:1 via BitGo Trust against short-term Treasuries, MMFs, and cash deposits.
collateral: Short-term U.S. government Treasury bills, U.S. dollar deposits, and other cash equivalents held by BitGo Trust Company
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption through BitGo Trust Company (issuer); arbitrage incentivizes peg maintenance

proofOfReserves.provider: Independent accounting firm via BitGo / Chainlink

jurisdiction.regulator: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC)
jurisdiction.license: National Trust Bank Charter (BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A.)

applicabilityBasis.summary: USD1 is a U.S. dollar payment stablecoin issued 1:1 via BitGo Trust infrastructure with reserve attestations and public redemption policy — squarely within the apparent-payment-stablecoin definition.

genius.issuerEntity: BitGo Trust Company / BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. (OCC conditional approval Dec 2025; current issuer); WLTC Holdings LLC / World Liberty Trust Company, N.A. (de novo OCC national trust charter application pending, filed Jan 2026)
genius.licensingRegulator: OCC (BitGo Bank & Trust conditional approval Dec 2025; WLTC Holdings OCC application Jan 2026)
genius.notes: USD1 is legally issued by BitGo Trust Company (operating post-conditional-OCC-approval as BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A.); World Liberty Financial Inc. is the brand sponsor/co-founder. In January 2026, WLTC Holdings LLC (a WLFI subsidiary) filed a de novo OCC national trust bank charter application to establish World Liberty Trust Company, N.A., which would take over direct issuance and custody of USD1 if approved. The OCC charter applications are under existing OCC authority — not GENIUS Act PPSI applications. No GENIUS PPSI framework has been finalized; issuer-announced-intent remains the correct status. No token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official PPSI application was located.

mintAuthority.summary: USD1 is issuer-backed; the Ethereum token owner is an AccessControl controller whose defaultAdmin is a 3/6 Safe. MINTER_ROLE is held by that Safe, a BitGo 2/3 WalletSimple, and one EOA.

controls.label: USD1 token owner/controller
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294739, USD1 token owner() returned this controller contract (confirmed). controller defaultAdmin() returned 0x0D190B74 (the curated Safe). Contract has 12193 bytes bytecode.

controls.label: USD1 controller default-admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294739, controller defaultAdmin() returned this Safe (confirmed). Safe API: threshold=3, 6 owners, modules=[], guard=zero, masterCopy=0x41675C (Gnosis Safe 1.4.1). Also holds MINTER_ROLE on the controller directly.

controls.label: USD1 MINTER_ROLE BitGo WalletSimple
controls.evidence: At block 25294739, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x0f33afb0) returned true on the controller. Contract is a BitGo WalletSimple (EIP-1167 minimal proxy, WalletFactory 0xa7198f48); 2-of-3 multisig with signers 0xd8fab08c, 0xb7ef75ec, 0x833b62b1 confirmed via isSigner() reads and creation log.

controls.label: USD1 MINTER_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: At block 25294739, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x87e001) returned true on the controller. eth_getCode returned empty (EOA confirmed). Issuer-backend minting endpoint.

review.evidence: At block 25294739: token owner() = controller 0xee9b1a09 (contract, confirmed). Controller defaultAdmin() = 3/6 Safe 0x0D190B74 (Safe API snapshot: 6 owners, no modules, guard=zero). MINTER_ROLE active holders: Safe 0x0D190B74, BitGo WalletSimple 0x0f33afb0 (2/3 signers confirmed), EOA 0x87e001. One earlier MINTER_ROLE holder (0xf9e47d37) revoked. All on-chain mint surfaces confirmed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USD1 cross-chain transfers are documented by World Liberty Financial as using a Chainlink CCIP bridge across integrated networks. That puts durable cross-chain movement on an external validated messaging network rather than a canonical rollup bridge.
